source_title: A review of the impact of formative assessment on student achievement in mathematics
publisher: NOMAD Nordic Studies in Mathematics Education 22(3)
exact_quote_or_excerpt: The results show positive relations between student achievement in mathematics and the ways of doing formative assessment.
finding: Formative assessment is positively related to maths achievement, which supports the value of diagnosis but not that centres would pay for a tool.
limitations: Abstract-level; academic evidence on learning, not on purchasing by centres. Gap: Does not address primary-level diagnosis tools or purchasing by tuition centres.

source_title: Singapore families spent S$1.8 billion on private tuition in 2023
publisher: Malay Mail (citing Straits Times / SingStat household expenditure survey)
exact_quote_or_excerpt: Families in Singapore reportedly spent S$1.8 billion (RM6 billion) on private tuition for their children in 2023
finding: Households spend heavily on private tuition, so centres have paying customers; it does not show centres would buy diagnostic software.
limitations: Secondary report; primary SingStat table not opened. All subjects and levels, not primary maths. Household spending on tuition, not centre spending on software.

exact_quote_or_excerpt: Proficiency Reports with KooBits Parent App
finding: Parent-facing practice app with proficiency reports; no evidence of tutor-reviewed gap reports for centres.
limitations: Company self-description on its own website; features and price not independently tested.

source_title: Geniebook: Geniebook subscription (Maths, Science, English, P1 to Sec 4)
exact_quote_or_excerpt: Get a free diagnostic report of your child's strengths & weaknesses
finding: Offers a free diagnostic report of strengths and weaknesses to parents, overlapping with gap diagnosis.
limitations: Company self-description on its own website; features and price not independently tested.

source_title: Singapore's education ministry to deploy more AI in schools after success of Primary 5 maths tool
exact_quote_or_excerpt: uses machine learning to make customised learning recommendations for each student
finding: MOE already gives schools an ML-based adaptive maths system, a free alternative in schools.
limitations: 2023 article; current coverage (levels, topics) not checked on an MOE page. Price to schools not stated. A state-provided alternative in schools, not in tuition centres.
